offers.title: Customer Support Specialist - DACH
offers.description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location.

As a Customer Support Specialist, you’ll be at the heart of how our DACH customers experience Tellent. You’ll help customers get the most out of our Talent Management Suite by solving problems, answering questions, investigating issues and turning customer feedback into opportunities to improve our products and how we support them.

You’ll become a trusted expert across our products Tellent Recruitee and Tellent HR Manage, combining strong product and technical knowledge with empathy, critical thinking and AI-powered support tools. Beyond resolving individual customer questions, you’ll help us identify patterns, improve our knowledge and processes, and contribute to making Support better for both our customers and our teams.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You’ll learn the Tellent products, our customers, Support processes and tools, while building confidence in handling customer conversations independently. You’ll start resolving customer questions and issues with support from your teammates and identify your first opportunities to improve how we work.

  • Within 6 months: You’ll work with increasing autonomy across your assigned product areas and become a trusted point of contact for our DACH customers. You’ll take ownership of more complex problems, use AI and other support tools effectively, contribute to knowledge sharing and take part in a project or improvement initiative beyond your day-to-day customer work.

  • After 1 year: You’ll have developed strong product and technical expertise and be able to confidently investigate and resolve a broad range of customer problems. You’ll actively share your knowledge with peers, recognise recurring customer and product patterns, and contribute to improvements across Support and the wider organisation.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Own customer conversations: Provide friendly, precise and personalised support across our support channels, taking ownership of customer questions from first contact through to resolution.

  • Investigate & resolve problems: Use your product knowledge, technical skills, context and available tools to understand what is really happening, troubleshoot issues and identify the right resolution before escalating when needed.

  • Become a product expert: Build deep knowledge of Tellent’s products and use that expertise to educate customers, explain complex topics clearly and act as a voice of the customer internally.

  • Use AI effectively: Work with AI-powered support tools to resolve customer questions efficiently while critically reviewing AI-generated information for accuracy, relevance and customer impact. Know when AI is appropriate, when human judgement is needed and when an issue requires escalation.

  • Improve how we work: Identify recurring questions, product issues and opportunities for improvement. Contribute to our Help Center, internal knowledge base, AI knowledge and Support processes to make information more useful for customers, colleagues and AI.

  • Create impact beyond tickets: Take ownership of side projects and improvement initiatives that help develop yourself, the Support team and the wider company.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with fellow Support Specialists, Team Leads and our Tech Support team, as well as Product, Engineering, Customer Success and other customer-facing teams to solve problems and turn customer insights into meaningful improvements.

What You Bring

  • Customer support experience: Entry-level experience in customer support, customer care or another client-facing role where you’ve been responsible for solving problems, explaining technical concepts clearly and delivering a great customer experience.

  • Language skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills in German (minimum C1 level or higher) and English (minimum B2 level or higher).

  • Critical Thinking & AI: Context-driven problem solver who uses data, curiosity, and modern AI tools to find accurate solutions.

  • Ownership & Collaboration: Adaptable, reliable, receptive to feedback, and eager to contribute to team success.

What We Offer

  • Remote or hybrid working across Netherlands, Germany, and Poland

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget + internal learning opportunities

  • Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 wellbeing days in 2026

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • €200 home office budget

About Tellent

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

With 250+ team members globally, 7,000+ customers in 100+ countries, and a growing ecosystem of 500+ partners, we help organizations attract, grow, and retain top talent — and we’re just getting started.

Your journey with us is guided by people, supported by tech. Curious about how it works? Read our AI Statement, check our Privacy Policy, or chat with us at hr@tellent.com.

offers.title: Digital Customer Success Manager - Benelux
offers.description:
As a Digital Customer Success Manager for the Benelux market, you will partner closely with another Digital CSM to co-manage and retain a critical segment of roughly 1,300 small-to-mid market customers in the Benelux region. Instead of traditional 1:1 management, you will leverage product data, AI, automation, and localized multi-channel outreach to drive product adoption and directly impact Gross Revenue Retention (GRR). This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity for an operations-minded self-starter to test, roll out, and iterate digital initiatives in a dynamic growth-stage SaaS environment.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You will get to know the team, the products, and our customer dynamics. You'll join customer calls, master Tellent's digital CS tools, and manage select, high-value reactive customer requests to build baseline product empathy, always with the goal of translating these patterns into scalable, automated solutions.

  • Within 6 months: Spearhead the end-to-end design, localization, and rollout of a critical digital program (such as onboarding or churn-prevention) in Benelux market. You will partner actively with Account Managers to translate data-driven usage trends into concrete renewal and upsell opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You have truly left your mark on our digital customer journey! By building and scaling programs that measurably increase product adoption, you have turned your ideas into standard operating processes and established yourself as a key driver of Tellent's long-term retention.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Customer Success at Scale: Proactively guide and safeguard the segment using scalable, one-to-many communication rather than traditional relationship-heavy 1:1 management.

  • Drive Digital Adoption & Retention Programs: Develop, roll out, and iterate on digital programs utilizing channels such as email, in-app banners, chats, videos, and webinars, primarily tailored for our Benelux audience.

  • Analyze Customer Data & Insights: Regularly monitor Benelux segment retention, adoption, and engagement metrics to proactively identify patterns, target silent or low-engagement accounts, and measure campaign effectiveness.

  • Surface Growth & Expansion Signals: Monitor regional usage signals to identify and qualify upsell or cross-sell opportunities, passing these actionable leads directly to the local AM team.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with your peer Benelux Digital CSM, local Account Management, Support, Ops, Product Marketing, and Product to scale customer outcomes and launch seamless digital workflows.

What You Bring

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills in Dutch (minimum C1 level or higher) and English (minimum B2 level or higher).

  • Confident Customer Engagement: Experience in customer-facing roles with a proven ability to drive outcomes through your interactions. You have no stage fright, genuinely enjoy engaging with strangers, and feel right at home presenting a webinar in both Dutch and English.

  • A Systems Mindset: Natural process-oriented thinking; you enjoy organizing chaotic workflows, look for ways to scale your work, and are comfortable working with data, dashboards (like Metabase), and pattern-spotting. Experience with systems like Planhat, HubSpot, and Intercom is highly valued.

  • Self-Starter: An entrepreneurial mindset with a natural drive to innovate. You proactively seek out answers independently, experiment with solutions, and don't wait for a manual to make processes run better.

  • Adaptability: You thrive in an environment that is not heavily predefined and are excited by the opportunity to help design and build new processes from scratch.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid working from our canal-side Amsterdam office

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget + 2 dedicated learning days

  • Pension plan, wellness perks & commuting/travel reimbursement

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days in 2026

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year

  • Apple MacBook and all the tools you need to succeed

  • €200 home office budget + work-from-home allowance

offers.title: Principal Product Security Engineer
offers.description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location.

About the role

We're looking for a Principal Product Security Engineer to shape how we design, build, and ship secure software at Tellent.

This is a new, hands-on role sitting directly within Engineering. At least 30% of your time will be spent actively looking for vulnerabilities in our own products. The rest will focus on making sure the next vulnerability doesn't get written in the first place - through threat modelling, secure-by-default patterns, and close collaboration with our engineering teams.

Your goal won't simply be to find and fix individual vulnerabilities. You'll help us understand their root causes and eliminate whole classes of security issues across our products.

You'll work alongside our engineering leads and closely with our existing Security and GRC team. They own corporate security policy, certification, risk and incident response; you'll focus on product security, close to our engineers, architecture and code.

This isn't a gatekeeper role. Your impact will come from partnering with teams, building trust, and creating solutions that make the secure way the easiest way to build.

As our first dedicated Principal Product Security Engineer, you'll also have significant influence over how the function develops. We'll bring the context and priorities; you'll help turn them into a product security roadmap and own the technical direction from there.

Your First Year at Tellent

First 3 months: You'll get to know our architecture, products and engineering teams while building a clear picture of our current threat landscape. Through hands-on review and offensive testing, you'll deliver a credible, prioritised assessment of our most important product security risks.

Within 6 months: You'll have threat models in place for our highest-risk surfaces, including our AI features, with the most serious gaps either addressed or credibly planned. You'll have shipped at least one systemic improvement that removes a class of vulnerability rather than fixing a single instance.

After 1 year: Secure-by-default standards and paved paths will be increasingly embedded into how our teams build. Engineers will involve you during design rather than only before launch, and we'll be catching more serious security issues internally before they reach us from outside.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Perform deep manual security reviews and offensive testing across our services, APIs and clients, with particular attention to authorization, multi-tenancy, business logic and other high-risk areas.

  • Threat model our highest-risk product surfaces, including new AI functionality, and help teams develop the skills to eventually run this practice themselves.

  • Own the technical strategy for our application security tooling, currently Aikido, focusing on actionable signal, developer experience and low false-positive rates.

  • Triage vulnerabilities from internal tooling, penetration tests and external researchers, make severity calls you can defend, and partner with teams to verify that fixes work.

  • Identify patterns and root causes across findings and build systemic fixes, secure-by-default libraries and paved paths that prevent vulnerabilities from recurring.

  • Develop secure development standards that engineers can use in their day-to-day work.

  • Partner with our Security team on our bug bounty programe, pentest remediation, security champions network and training based on real findings.

  • Act as a senior technical partner for product security incidents and when security or privacy commitments require engineering controls.

  • Shape and own our product security roadmap, working across Backend, Frontend, QA, DevOps, Product and Security.

What You'll Bring

The profile that will likely thrive in this role is someone with a strong engineering foundation who moved deeper into security and is still comfortable working directly with code.

  • Deep hands-on application or product security experience, ideally built across both engineering and security roles.

  • Strong examples of vulnerabilities you've personally identified and can walk us through, from forming the hypothesis and proving the impact to getting the issue fixed.

  • Strong understanding of areas such as access control and multi-tenancy, authentication and authorization, session management, injection vulnerabilities, SSRF, deserialization, business logic abuse and supply-chain risk.

  • Hands-on engineering skills. You're comfortable reading and writing production code and reasoning about unfamiliar systems and technologies.

  • Experience threat modelling real systems and translating findings into practical engineering work.

  • Working knowledge of cloud security, containers, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.

  • A technology-agnostic mindset. You're comfortable moving between different languages, stacks and environments depending on the problem you're solving.

  • Excellent communication skills. You can explain a subtle vulnerability to the engineer who wrote the code and discuss the resulting trade-offs with senior stakeholders.

  • A collaborative, low-ego approach. You see product security as an enabling function and build relationships that make teams want to involve you early.

Experience with AI and LLM application security, including prompt injection, excessive agency and data leakage through model context or RAG, would be particularly valuable. Experience with privacy engineering, identity systems such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC and SAML, offensive security, company or platform integrations, or building a product security practice from an early stage would also be a plus.

Certifications such as OSCP, CISSP, CISM or CSSLP are welcome, but not required. Practical experience matters more to us than certifications.

Familiarity with technologies already used across Tellent is helpful, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing our entire stack. We'd rather hire a strong, adaptable security engineer who can learn our systems than someone tied to one particular technology.

What We Offer

  • Hybrid or remote working setup across the Netherlands, Germany and Poland.

  • The opportunity to establish and shape product security within our Engineering organisation from the ground up.

  • Significant autonomy and direct collaboration with our VP of Engineering and engineering leadership.

  • A diverse, multicultural and remote-friendly environment.

  • €1,500 annual training budget + 2 dedicated learning days.

  • Dedicated tooling budget and opportunities to stay connected to the wider security community through conferences and research.

  • Pension plan, travel reimbursement and wellness perks.

  • 28 paid holiday days + 2 additional days to relax.

  • Work from anywhere for 4 weeks per year.

  • Apple MacBook and top-tier tooling.

  • €200 home office budget.

Please note: Benefits may differ based on your employment location.

About Tellent

Tellent is a Talent Management Suite that helps organizations attract, hire, manage, and grow their people. Our platform combines Applicant Tracking, HRIS, and Performance Management solutions used by 7,000+ companies across 100+ countries.

With 250+ employees across Europe, we're building intuitive and scalable HR technology that helps companies create better employee experiences.

The products we build handle some of the most sensitive information people share in their working lives — from candidate applications and employee records to performance data. Security and privacy therefore can't simply be bolted on afterwards; they need to be part of how our products are designed and built. This becomes even more important as we introduce AI-powered functionality across our products.

offers.description:
Note: The listed salary range is based on the salary range for the Netherlands. Salary ranges may vary by location.

About the role

Join the team behind Tellent Recruitee, our Applicant Tracking System trusted by thousands of organizations around the world to attract and hire great people. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help evolve a product where reliability, scalability, and a great user experience matter.

You'll join Team Hire, a collaborative group of Backend and Frontend Engineers, working closely with Design, QA, and DevOps to solve complex problems at scale. We're looking for an engineer who combines strong technical skills with a product mindset: someone who asks "why?" before building, thinks about the impact on users, and helps the team find pragmatic solutions to technical challenges.

Your primary focus will be backend development in Elixir, working on both new capabilities and the modernization of our existing codebase. Whether you're already experienced with Elixir or coming from another backend technology such as Ruby on Rails, Python, Java, or PHP, you'll have the support of experienced teammates as you deepen your expertise.

Your First Year at Tellent

First 3 months: You'll get to know the team, our product, and our architecture while contributing to your first meaningful improvements. You'll become familiar with our engineering practices and ways of working, supported by experienced teammates as you get up to speed with our Elixir stack.

Within 6 months: You'll take ownership of features and contribute to technical discussions, code reviews, and improvements to the scalability, reliability, and maintainability of the platform. You'll work closely with your teammates to solve customer problems and deliver valuable product improvements.

After 1 year: You'll be a trusted technical partner within the team, taking ownership of significant parts of the product and contributing to technical decisions and architectural discussions. You'll also help share knowledge across the team through collaboration, pair programming, and mentoring.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and improve reliable, scalable backend solutions for Tellent Recruitee, our core Applicant Tracking System used by thousands of organizations globally.

  • Develop new capabilities while also modernizing and improving our existing codebase to increase performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Design and implement solutions that balance technical quality with customer and business needs.

  • Take ownership of the features you deliver, ensuring they are well-tested, maintainable, and meet our quality standards.

  • Investigate and resolve bugs and technical issues to help maintain a stable and reliable experience for our customers.

  • Participate in technical discussions and contribute to system design and architectural decisions, with support from more experienced teammates where needed.

  • Collaborate closely with Backend and Frontend Engineers, Design, QA, and DevOps to solve complex problems and deliver valuable product improvements.

  • Participate in pair programming, code reviews, and real-time problem solving to share knowledge and continuously improve how we work.

What You'll Bring

  • Commercial experience with Elixir, or strong backend development experience in technologies such as Ruby on Rails, Python, Java, or PHP combined with a strong motivation to learn Elixir.

  • Experience designing and building scalable applications and a solid understanding of databases, preferably PostgreSQL.

  • General knowledge of Elasticsearch and RabbitMQ.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a pragmatic approach to maintaining and improving existing applications.

  • A strong focus on quality and reliability, while understanding that good engineering also means making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • A product mindset: you don't simply implement specifications; you ask questions, think about the problem we're solving for users, and consider technical trade-offs.

  • A collaborative approach and willingness to participate in pair programming, technical discussions, and knowledge sharing.

  • Experience with messaging systems at scale, such as transactional email or push notifications, is a plus.

  • Fluent in English; Polish is a plus.

What we offer

  • Hybrid or remote working setup across Amsterdam, the Cologne area, and Poland

  • A chance to shape one of the most ambitious scale-ups in Europe and lead a company-defining tech transition.

  • Work in a diverse, multicultural, and remote-friendly team.

offers.title: Senior Partner Manager - DACH
offers.description:
About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Partner Performance: Monitor partner health, pipeline and revenue performance, identify risks early, and hold partners accountable to agreed activities and results.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Account & Whitespace Planning: Work side by side with strategic partners to analyse their customer base, identify whitespace opportunities and build plans to generate new business together.

  • Partner Acquisition: Identify, qualify and recruit high-potential new partners, particularly across the HR ecosystem, assessing them based on strategic fit and revenue potential.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

What We Offer

  • Flexible working in the Cologne area as we continue building our local team presence

  • Diverse and international team environment

  • €1,500 annual learning budget
